title_ar: فتوى بشأن حادثة إحراق نسخة من المصحف الشريف في السويد
title_en: A Fatwa Concerning the Incident of the Burning of a Copy of the Noble Qur'an in Sweden
body_ar:
الحمد لله ذي الجبروت والملكوت والكبرياء والعظمة، الذي "..يُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦٓۚ"، و"يُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَن تَزُولَاۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَهُمَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓۚ"، "يَسۡ‍َٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ"، (عز جاره وجل ثناؤه وتقدست أسماؤه ولا حول ولا قوة إلا به). أنزل هذا القرءان العظيم تبيانا لكل شيء، وتولى حفظه بنفسه، وختم به خطابه إلى أهل الأرض، وجعله مصدقا لما بين يديه من الحق ومهيمنا عليه، هو كلام الله، فِيهِ نَبَؤ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ، وَخَبَرُ مَا بَعْدَكُمْ، وَحُكْمُ مَا بَيْنَكُمْ، وَهُوَ الْفَصْلُ لَيْسَ بِالْهَزْلِ، مَنْ تَرَكَهُ مِنْ جَبَّارٍ قَصَمَهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنِ ابْتَغَى الْهُدَى فِي غَيْرِهِ أَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَهُوَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ الْمَتِينُ، وَهُوَ الذِّكْرُ الْحَكِيمُ، وَهُوَ الصِّرَاطُ الْمُسْتَقِيمُ، هُوَ الَّذِي لَا تَزِيغُ بِهِ الْأَهْوَاءُ، وَلَا تَلْتَبِسُ بِهِ الْأَلْسِنَةُ، وَلَا يَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ الْعُلَمَاءُ، وَلَا يَخْلَقُ عَلَى كَثْرَةِ الرَّدِّ، وَلَا تَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُهُ، هُوَ الَّذِي لَمْ تَنْتَهِ الْجِنُّ إِذْ سَمِعَتْهُ حَتَّى قَالُوا: "إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ"، مَنْ قَالَ بِهِ صَدَقَ، وَمَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ أجِرَ، وَمَنْ حَكَمَ بِهِ عَدَلَ، وَمَنْ دَعَا إِلَيْهِ هُدِيَ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
أما بعد فقد رأيتم وسمعتم معاشر المسلمين ما أقدم عليه خبيث من الدانمارك بإذن رسمي وحماية تامة وتشجيع من حكومة السويد وفي عاصمتها وأمام سفارة تركيا فيها وتبجح وسائل الإعلام الغربية بذلك يظنون أنهم بهذه الجريمة يعاقبون تركيا على عدم قبولها لانضمام السويد ودول أخرى مثلها راعية للإرهاب إلى حلف النيتو، وما لحق ذلك من فعلة المجرم الخبيث في هولندا بحماية شرطتها أيضا. فوجب بيان الحكم الشرعي المترتب على هذه الجريمة التي تدخل في نطاق سلسلة من الجرائم تستهدف الإسلام ومقدساته، كالإساءة إلى الرسول الأعظم صلى الله عليه وسلم، وشيطنة المسلمين وغير ذلك. فأقول إنه يترتب على هذه الجريمة:
• وجوب قطع كل الدول الإسلامية علاقاتها مع حكومة السويد حتى تعتذر عن هذه الجريمة اعتذارا رسميا، ولا تكفي دعواهم للتعاطف مع المسلمين لأن الواقع يكذبه.
• وجوب مقاطعة الشعوب المسلمة لكل المنتجات السويدية حتى تعلن الاعتذار.
• يجب على جميع المسلمين التحرك بحسب ما تسمح به قوانين بلادهم للاحتجاج على هذه الجريمة ونظائرها.
• يجب على الإعلاميين التشهير بهذه الجريمة والتوعية بخطرها وضررها.
• يجب على خطباء المساجد وعلى الدعاة بذل الجهد في ذلك.
كل ذلك انطلاقا من وجوب تعظيم حرمات الله وشعائره، والنصح لكتابه ورسوله، وقياما بشعيرة إنكار المنكر وتغييره، وغضبا لله تعالى وغيرة على حرماته وغضبا للقرآن. فقد أخرج الطبراني في المعجم الأوسط عن أبي الدَّرداءِ قال: سأَلْتُ عائشةَ عن خُلُقِ رسولِ اللهِ فقالت: (كان خُلُقُه القُرآنَ يغضَبُ لغضَبِه ويَرضى لرضاه).
وفق الله المسلمين أجمعين لتحكيم شرعه الحنيف، وكتب الذلة والصغار على المعرضين المدبرين، وأنزل بالمسيئين المجرمين قوارع بأسه وعاجل عقوبته.

كتبه محمد الحسن بن الددو الشنقيطي
body_en:
Praise belongs to God, Possessor of omnipotence and of dominion, of grandeur and of greatness, who {… holds the sky back from falling upon the earth except by His leave} (Sūrat al-Ḥajj 22:65), and who {holds the heavens and the earth back from ceasing to be; and were they to cease, no one could hold them after Him} (Sūrat Fāṭir 35:41); {all who are in the heavens and the earth ask of Him; every day He is upon some matter} (Sūrat al-Raḥmān 55:29) — mighty is His protection, exalted is His praise, and holy are His names; and there is no power and no strength except through Him. He sent down this mighty Qur'an as a clarification of every thing, took upon Himself its preservation, sealed with it His address to the people of the earth, and made it confirming of the truth that came before it and a guardian over it. It is the speech of God: in it is the tidings of what was before you, and the report of what comes after you, and the judgement of what is between you. It is the decisive word and is no jest. Whatever tyrant abandons it, God breaks him; and whoever seeks guidance in anything other than it, God leads him astray. It is God's firm rope, it is the Wise Remembrance, and it is the straight path. It is that which the passions cannot make deviate, which tongues cannot confound, of which the scholars never have their fill, which does not wear out however often it is repeated, and whose wonders never come to an end. It is that which the jinn did not stop short of when they heard it, until they said: {We have heard a wondrous recitation, guiding to right conduct} (Sūrat al-Jinn 72:1-2). Whoever speaks by it speaks the truth; whoever acts by it is rewarded; whoever judges by it is just; and whoever calls to it is guided to a straight path.
To proceed: you have seen and heard, company of Muslims, what a vile man from Denmark has undertaken — with official permission, full protection and encouragement from the government of Sweden, in its capital, and in front of the embassy of Turkey there — and the Western media outlets' boasting of it, supposing that by this crime they are punishing Turkey for not accepting the accession of Sweden and other states like it, sponsors of terrorism, to the NATO alliance; and what followed it of the deed of the vile criminal in Holland, under the protection of its police as well. It has therefore become obligatory to set out the Sharia ruling that follows upon this crime, which falls within the scope of a series of crimes directed at Islam and its sanctities — such as the insulting of the greatest Messenger, God bless him and grant him peace, and the demonising of Muslims, and other than that. So I say that there follows upon this crime:
• The obligation (wujūb) upon all the Islamic states to sever their relations with the government of Sweden until it apologises for this crime with an official apology; and their claim to sympathy with the Muslims is not sufficient, because the reality belies it.
• The obligation upon the Muslim peoples to boycott all Swedish products until it announces an apology.
• It is obligatory upon all Muslims to act, in accordance with what the laws of their countries permit, in protest against this crime and its like.
• It is obligatory upon media people to expose this crime publicly and to make people aware of its danger and its harm.
• It is obligatory upon the preachers of the mosques and upon those who call people to Islam to exert themselves in that.
All of that proceeds from the obligation to magnify God's sanctities and His rites, from sincere counsel towards His Book and His Messenger, from fulfilling the rite of denouncing wrong and changing it, and from anger for God Almighty, protective zeal for His sanctities, and anger on behalf of the Qur'an. For al-Tabarani narrated in al-Muʿjam al-Awsaṭ from Abu al-Darda', who said: I asked Aisha about the character of the Messenger of God, and she said: (His character was the Qur'an; he grew angry at its anger and was pleased at what pleased it.)
May God grant all the Muslims success in ruling by His upright law; and may He write abasement and littleness upon those who turn away and turn their backs; and may He send down upon the offending criminals the crushing blows of His might and His swift punishment.

Written by Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew al-Shinqiti

flags.arabic: يجب على جميع المسلمين التحرك بحسب ما تسمح به قوانين بلادهم للاحتجاج على هذه الجريمة ونظائرها
flags.context: the third of the five obligations the fatwa sets out
options: It is obligatory upon all Muslims to act, in accordance with what the laws of their countries permit, in protest against this crime and its like
All Muslims must move, within the limits their national laws allow, to protest against this crime and others like it
Muslims everywhere are obliged to protest this crime by whatever means their country's laws permit
flags.note: The qualifying clause بحسب ما تسمح به قوانين بلادهم is the most consequential phrase in the fatwa and must sit where the Arabic puts it, inside the obligation and not after it. The Sheikh confines the required action to what national law allows; a translation that moved or weakened the clause would turn a call to lawful protest into something else. Flagged for a reviewer's attention precisely because it is load-bearing, not because it is doubtful.

flags.arabic: وجوب قطع كل الدول الإسلامية علاقاتها مع حكومة السويد
flags.context: the first of the five obligations
options: The obligation (wujūb) upon all the Islamic states to sever their relations with the government of Sweden
All Islamic states are obliged to cut off relations with the Swedish government
Islamic states must break off relations with Sweden
flags.note: wujūb is the verbal noun of the glossary's wājib and is rendered 'obligation'. Option 2 collapses it to a bare 'must', which style guide section 3 forbids. Note also that the obligation is stated of the states and of the peoples respectively, and the English keeps those addressees distinct.

flags.context: the fatwa's characterisation of Sweden and of other states in the NATO accession dispute
options: and other states like it, sponsors of terrorism
and other states like it which sponsor terrorism
and other similar states that patronise terrorism
flags.note: The Arabic is an apposition, not a relative clause, and the English keeps it as one. The characterisation is the Sheikh's own and is stated of named states; it has not been softened, attributed away or qualified. It is the principal reason this record is marked for editorial review.

flags.context: the vowelled passage in the opening in praise of the Qur'an
options: translate as the Sheikh's own prose, as served
mark it as the hadith on the merits of the Qur'an and supply the attribution
mark it as a quotation of unstated origin
flags.note: This passage is the well-known report on the merits of the Qur'an, usually cited from al-Tirmidhi and widely graded weak. The Sheikh gives it here without any attribution and without quotation marks, running it into his own prose, and style guide section 4 forbids adding a grading or an attribution he did not give. It is therefore translated as served. The vowelling in the source marks it as quoted material, which is why this is flagged rather than passed over.

translator_notes: A complete fatwa in the Sheikh's own hand, signed at the foot. It is not an excerpt and it reaches its ruling.

The Qur'anic quotations are rendered in curly quotation marks with references per style guide section 4. Qur'anic renderings in this corpus are interpretive and not a substitute for the Arabic. The source's leading ellipsis inside the first quotation marks the verse beginning mid-sentence and is reproduced.
The body_ar preserves the Qur'anic orthography of the source, including the superscript alef, the small high marks and the waṣlah on the definite article. Nothing has been normalised.

حلف النيتو is the source's spelling of NATO, which standard Arabic writes الناتو. Preserved in body_ar and rendered 'the NATO alliance' in body_en, per style guide section 11 on not silently fixing the source.

خبيث is rendered 'vile' both times it occurs. It is a strong term of moral disgust and has been neither softened nor sharpened; the person referred to is not named in the record and has not been named here.
إنكار المنكر is rendered 'denouncing wrong', staying close to the glossary's 'forbidding wrong' for al-nahy ʿan al-munkar while keeping the source's different word visible.

The closing sentence is an imprecation in the form of a supplication. It has been translated as what it is; the site should not present it as part of the operative ruling, which ends at the five bullets and the sentence that grounds them.
editorial_review_reasons: The fatwa states as an obligation that all Islamic states sever diplomatic relations with the government of Sweden and that Muslim peoples boycott all Swedish products. Published in English, a call to boycott a named state's products engages consumer-boycott and, in some European jurisdictions, anti-discrimination and commercial law; it is at minimum a significant reputational exposure for Ummah Collective.

The text describes Sweden and unnamed other states as sponsors of terrorism. Stated of identifiable states, this is a defamatory characterisation in the ordinary sense of several Western legal systems.

The closing supplication asks God to send down punishment on the offenders. It is an imprecation in a religious register and not a call to human action, but in English, next to a list of obligations, it can be read as continuous with them. The record should not be displayed without that separation being visible.

Against all of this, the fatwa expressly confines the action required of individual Muslims to what the laws of their own countries permit. That qualification must not be dropped or moved in any presentation of this record, and it is the strongest evidence that the text does not call for unlawful action.
Translated faithfully throughout, neither softened nor strengthened. The decision whether and how to publish belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.
